headlines.title: 하루 500만배럴 또 묶였다…사우디 송유관 피격 "잠정 운영 중단"
headlines.summary: 사우디아라비아 히자즈주 메디나 지역의 동서 파이프라인에서 검은 연기가 피어오르는 모습이 위성 사진에 포착됐다. /로이터=뉴스1 사우디아라비아가 이란의 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄에 대응해 원유 우회 수송의 핵심 축으로 활용해 온 '동서 파이프라인'이 드론 공격을 받아 전면 운영 중단됐다고 로이터 통신이 11일(현지시간) 사우디 국영매체를 인용해 보도했다.

headlines.title: 美 국채금리 ‘마의 5%’ 돌파… 韓 이자급증·투자감소 ‘연쇄 파장’
headlines.summary: ■ 글로벌 채권시장 긴장 고조 고유가·인플레·재정악화 영향 ‘경제 체온계’ 10년물 채권 발작 AI기업들 인프라 투자 빨라져 ‘5% 금리’ 뉴노멀 굳어질 수도 14일 미국 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)에서 한 트레이더가 모니터를 통해 각종 지표를 확인하고 있다. 이날 미국 10년 만기 국채 금리가 장중 5%를 넘어 2023년 10월 이후 최고치를 기록했다.

headlines.title: 유가 급등에 美 10년물 5% 돌파…AI 관련주 '휘청'(종합)
headlines.summary: 국제유가 급등이 직접 원인 재정적자·AI 투자용 회사채 발행까지 겹쳐 AI 관련주 급락…증시 고평가 부담도 확대 베선트 장기채 바이백에도 금리 상승 글로벌 장기금리의 벤치마크 역할을 하는 미국 10년 만기 국채 금리가 결국 5%를 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 회사채 만기 돌아오는데 … 국내기업 자금조달 ‘ 경고등 ’
headlines.summary: 고금리에 R&D 등 지연 예상 당국은 ‘긴급 바이백’ 검토 미국 국채 10년물 금리가 5%를 돌파하면서 국내 기업들의 조달비용 부담에도 경고등이 켜졌다. 글로벌 채권금리 상승세가 국내 시장금리를 끌어올리면서 기업들이 회사채를 새로 발행하거나 만기 도래 물량을 차환할 때 부담해야 할 이자 비용이 커질 수 있다.

headlines.title: 국세청, ‘ 물가불안 조장 ’ 탈세 혐의 41곳 세무조사
headlines.summary: 배민, 1조대 국내 이익 獨 모회사 이전 ‘금란’ 양계장·무신사 패션플랫폼 조사 국세청이 추석을 앞두고 먹거리와 배달·패션 플랫폼 등 생활물가 밀접 업종의 탈루 혐의 업체 41곳에 대해 세무조사에 착수했다. 국세청은 농축산물·가공식품·외식 프랜차이즈 등 먹거리 관련 업체와 소비재 플랫폼 업체에서 탈루 혐의를 포착했다고 15일 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 8월 수출 983억달러 '역대 최대' … 반도체가 또 견인

key_headlines.summary: South Korea achieved record August exports of 98.3 billion dollars, with semiconductor exports surging 206.1% year-over-year to 46.8 billion dollars, marking 18 consecutive months of growth.

key_headlines.title: US Treasury Yields Breach Critical 5% Mark, Triggering Global Market Concerns
key_headlines.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield surpassed 5% for the first time since October 2023, raising concerns about increased interest expense in Korea and reduced investment as AI infrastructure spending accelerates globally.

key_headlines.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Hit Record High in Q2 2026, Memory Chips Account for 54%
key_headlines.summary: Global semiconductor industry achieved record Q2 2026 sales with memory chips representing 54% of revenues at 572 trillion won, driven by sustained AI demand despite moderation rhetoric.

key_headlines.title: Korean Ramen Exports Surge 21% to Exceed 1.5 Billion Dollars Annually
key_headlines.summary: K-food exports, particularly ramen, are accelerating with 21% growth, surpassing 1.5 billion dollars annually, benefiting significantly from tariff-free FTA effects with the US, China, and ASEAN.

key_headlines.title: Fed Raises Rates for First Time in 32 Months as Inflation Persists, Despite Trump Opposition
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve raised the benchmark interest rate by 0.25% for the first time since June 2023, signaling further increases ahead to combat persistent inflation, while President Trump criticizes the decision.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a semiconductor-driven boom with August exports reaching a record 98.3 billion dollars, with semiconductor sales surging 206.1% year-over-year. However, experts warn that Korea must use this golden opportunity to restructure traditional industries like automobiles, steel, and petrochemicals while developing next-generation sectors such as biotech and healthcare. The global semiconductor industry achieved record Q2 sales with memory chips representing 54% of revenues, indicating sustained strong demand despite AI development moderation discussions. Ramen and K-food exports are also performing exceptionally well, with ramen exports up 21% to 1.5 billion dollars annually, benefiting from FTA tariff elimination with major markets.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's Q2 nominal GDP growth reached 26.4% year-over-year, the highest rate in 47 years since Q3 1979, with growth expected to remain in the 3% range for 2026. The Korea Bank faces pressure from widening US-Korea rate differentials of 1%, with market expectations leaning toward a rate increase in November to address inflation concerns. The Federal Reserve raised rates by 0.25% in September, the first increase since June 2023, with plans to raise further before year-end, putting pressure on Korea's monetary policy decisions. Inflation remains a primary concern globally, with the US Treasury yield breaching the critical 5% threshold, affecting borrowing costs for Korean companies and the government.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI closed slightly negative at 6,715.41, declining 0.04% despite opening higher, as foreign investors net sold 2.2 trillion won while domestic institutions and retail investors showed net buying strength. The Korean won depreciated sharply by 13.6 won against the dollar in a single day, reaching 1,382.2 won per dollar, as concerns about prolonged US monetary tightening resurfaced. The KOSDAQ index rose 0.76% or 20 points to 822.18, showing resilience in technology stocks amid rate concerns. The currency market reaction reflects heightened nervousness among Korean companies regarding extended high interest rates and their impact on corporate debt and financing costs.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government's National Growth Fund is supporting 5 major projects worth 1 trillion won, including 25 billion won for auto parts manufacturer Hwashin's electric vehicle battery pack production line expansion. Semiconductor equipment supplier PKC is receiving 12 billion won for high-purity chlorine gas production facilities used in semiconductor etching processes. President Yoon emphasized that Korea's automobile industry is well-positioned to lead transportation electrification as EV prices decline and battery production capacity expands. Energy security and hydrogen industry development are becoming strategic priorities, with Hyundai Motor Group calling for predictable government policies to support long-term hydrogen investments.
sections.Real Estate: Samsung Electronics' new employee housing loan programs and semiconductor-related demand are boosting Hwaseong Dongtan property prices, which rose 0.63% in the second week of September and are trading in the 17-22 billion won range for 84-square-meter units. Posco Engineering and Construction is launching Arc Mer Dongtan Phase 2 with 1,808 units featuring floor areas of 84-188 square meters, located approximately 10 minutes walking distance from Samsung's Hwaseong plant. Taeyoung Construction is set to launch Gumi Park One Design in November with 1,355 units in Gumi, signaling recovery in the Gyeongbuk real estate market. Seoul's Bukgajwa 6 district reconstruction project received approval after 12 years, planning to develop 1,953 apartment units as part of urban renewal.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve's decision to raise rates by 0.25% marks the first increase since June 2023, with plans for additional hikes despite strong opposition from President Trump, who has repeatedly called for rate cuts to 1% or below. High global oil prices driven by Middle East tensions and persistent inflation forced the Fed to shift toward monetary tightening, contradicting the Trump administration's growth-focused agenda. The US 10-year Treasury yield breaching 5% is creating ripple effects across global markets, affecting currency values and investment flows. Korea faces spillover effects through exchange rate volatility, stock market pressure, and domestic interest rate considerations as the global monetary environment tightens.
sections.AI & Economy: Global AI competition has evolved into an 'AI 2.0' phase where 67 nations are investing government budgets in sovereign AI development, with investment increasing more than 26-fold from 6 projects in June 2023. Major tech companies like Anthropic are proposing AI development moderation and safety standards, though critics argue this may constitute anti-competitive behavior by dominant firms to limit competition from emerging economies like Korea and China. LG announced plans to focus on AI-related investments including AI factories, physical AI, semiconductor materials, and AI transformation across its business divisions. Hyundai Motor Group emphasizes hydrogen energy's critical role in supporting AI data centers and robotics infrastructure while transitioning to carbon-free power systems.
sections.Others: Seoul's data center vacancy rate has dropped to 1.1% as AI infrastructure demand surges, with 54% of units under construction already having signed leases, highlighting the shift from land-based to power-based competition in data center development. AI autonomous agents are rapidly evolving but introducing new security vulnerabilities, particularly indirect prompt injection attacks that could exploit AI systems to extract sensitive information. Busan city failed to prevent 3.3 billion won in unauthorized external transfers despite account separation measures, highlighting governance and accounting control challenges in public fund management. The debate continues over AI development pace, with industry leaders proposing moderation while governments globally accelerate investment in sovereign AI capabilities to ensure strategic autonomy.
